relationships.subject: mu-opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: it is believed that the activation of µ-opioid receptors suppresses tumor angiogenesis through the inhibition of hypoxia-inducible transcription factors (HIFs), which increases the expression of VEGF

relationships.subject: kappa-opioid receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: In the tumors, k-opioid was directly correlated with µ-opioid (p = 0.001) and TUNEL (p = 0.028)

relationships.subject: Ki-67
relationships.evidence_quote: however, Ki-67 was inversely correlated with VEGF (p = 0.018)

key_findings: Kappa-opioid receptor immunoexpression was lower in nodal metastases of recurrent tumors; mu-opioid receptor correlated with TUNEL in tumors and inversely with Ki-67 in nodal metastasis.
Neither opioid receptor was expressed in relation to VEGF in primary tumor or nodal metastasis.
